name: Bodyweight Standing Leg Curl
steps: Stand behind a chair or face a wall, touch it lightly for balance and shift onto one leg.
Keep your thighs aligned side by side and lift your working foot slightly off the floor.
Contract your hamstring smoothly to curl your working heel straight up toward your glute while keeping your working knee pointing straight down.
Lower your foot slowly back down just short of the floor, and switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Avoid letting your working knee swing forward as your heel rises, which shifts effort away from the hamstring.
Keep your torso upright and avoid arching your lower back to pull the heel higher.
